TheShatteredCrown.TSC_EnchantDef.label: warded
TheShatteredCrown.TSC_EnchantDef.description: A ward against harm, worked into the armor by someone who knew the old words. The wearer takes slightly less damage from everything.
TheShatteredCrown.TSC_EnchantDef.flavor: The blow lands, and some of it simply is not there.

TheShatteredCrown.TSC_EnchantDef.label: fleet
TheShatteredCrown.TSC_EnchantDef.description: A lightness worked into the armor: it carries some of its own weight, and a little of the wearer's besides.
TheShatteredCrown.TSC_EnchantDef.flavor: The road feels shorter in it.

TheShatteredCrown.TSC_EnchantDef.label: keen
TheShatteredCrown.TSC_EnchantDef.description: An old battle-blessing: every blow and every shot the wearer lands strikes a little harder.
TheShatteredCrown.TSC_EnchantDef.flavor: Edges bite deeper. Arrows arrive angrier.

TheShatteredCrown.TSC_EnchantDef.label: swift
TheShatteredCrown.TSC_EnchantDef.description: A quickness worked into the joints of the armor: the wearer swings, draws, and aims a little faster.
TheShatteredCrown.TSC_EnchantDef.flavor: The armor is never the thing that is late.
